pairs.name: ascii
pairs.alt: The dancer's upper body and swirling dress on a dark stage, original left and with ASCII right: the picture is rebuilt from small characters in a grid, dense signs like # and % where the dress is bright, dots and dashes in the shadows, each in the colour of the picture behind it, on dim square cells
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: ASCII at its default settings.

pairs.name: grid-glyph
pairs.alt: The dancer's upper body and swirling dress on a dark stage, original left and with Grid Glyph right: the picture is rebuilt from characters, each in its own square cell ruled by a thin line in the colour of the cell, so her dress becomes a lit table of # and % signs while the lines fade into the dark stage
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Grid Glyph at its default settings.
